Title: Architecture review gate A
Purpose: Stop after the baseline audit and materialization work, then perform the first strict senior-architect review before the run invests in deeper refactors.
Deliverables: Gap register with severity and owner
ValidationCommands: Review generated audit artifacts and confirm no hidden hardcoded template assumptions remain
ReviewQuestions: Is the repository finally aligned with the previous bundle’s claimed file-driven design?
Did the run avoid regressing current repo fixes while closing the missing-pack gap?
Is it safe to proceed into code-hardening and SQLite-focused changes?
CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a corrective subbundle, block the queue, and rerun gate A after the correction lands.
